extDescription.message: Lock your browser with a password. Every window closes until the right password is entered. Includes auto-lock, idle lock and a brute-force quarantine.

notifActivateBody.message: Click here to set a password and turn on protection.

notifIdleBody.message: You have been idle. Move the mouse or press a key to cancel.

notifLockedNewWindow.message: The browser is locked. Enter your password to open it.

lockErrorQuarantined.message: Quarantine is active. Wait until it ends.

lockQuarantineBody.message: $1 wrong attempts triggered quarantine. You can try again in $2 seconds.

lockToastQuarantined.message: Too many wrong attempts. Quarantine started.

lockToastAttempts.message: Wrong attempts: $1 of $2. Quarantine starts at $2.

setMainHelp.message: Master switch. While it is off, BrowserAway never locks the browser.

bannerInactive.message: BrowserAway is switched off, so your browser is not protected. Turn on the main switch and apply the changes.

bannerPrivateWindows.message: Private windows are not locked because BrowserAway may not run in them. Allow it under about:addons → BrowserAway → Run in Private Windows.

alDescription.message: Lock the browser automatically when it starts, and choose what opens after you unlock it.

alStartUrlHint.message: Opened in a fresh window after an automatic lock.

errInvalidUrl.message: Enter a valid web address (http or https).

qmHelp.message: After too many wrong passwords the lock screen refuses input for a while and can wipe browsing data.

qmDurationHint.message: After $1 wrong attempts the browser stays locked for $2 minute(s) and accepts no input.

qmClearHistoryHint.message: When $1 wrong attempts are reached, the selected data is deleted. Needs the browsing data permission.

qmPermissionDenied.message: Permission was not granted, so browsing data will not be cleared.

qmClearOptionsHint.message: Deleted when $1 wrong attempts trigger quarantine; covers the last $2 day(s).

qmClearDurationAlert.message: Warning: this permanently deletes the selected data from the last $1 day(s).

qlCombinationHint.message: Press Change, then type the new combination. Esc cancels.

qlInvalid.message: "$1" can't be used as a shortcut.

imDescription.message: Lock automatically when you have been away from the computer.

imDurationHint.message: Locks after $1 minute(s) without keyboard or mouse activity.

obWelcomeBody.message: Protect your browser with a password. When it is locked, every window closes and only the right password brings them back.

obPasswordBody.message: Choose a password with at least 6 characters. It cannot be recovered if you forget it.

errPasswordSame.message: The new password must differ from the old one.

pwDescription.message: Enter your current password, then choose a new one.

pwOldHint.message: The password you use to unlock.

pwNewHint.message: At least 6 characters, different from the old one.
